highPriorityContentBriefs.template: Best-of list with ranked card tiles showing cashback %, annual fee, and net annual value. Include a comparison table. End with /compare and /simulator CTAs.
highPriorityContentBriefs.rationale: This is the highest-volume Commercial query in the site's wheelhouse. The /cards page targets it but has no dedicated editorial pillar. Publishing this creates the C1 cluster anchor and immediately surfaces cashback card detail pages through internal links.
requiredSections: Introduction: Why cashback cards are better for most Indian consumers
Top 5 cashback credit cards ranked table (pull from /cards API data)
Detailed breakdown per card: cashback %, categories, annual fee, fee waiver threshold
Best card for online shopping sub-section (captures C1-S1 as internal link target)
Best card for groceries sub-section (captures C1-S2 as internal link target)
Cashback vs reward points explainer paragraph (internal link to C1-S3)
FAQ schema: 5 PAA questions
CTA: Use the Rewards Simulator to calculate your cashback
highPriorityContentBriefs.cannibalizationRisk: Low — /cards targets a broader keyword; this post targets the cashback-specific sub-segment
